steps.say: A tally chart uses marks. A gate of 5 is quick to count.
A pictogram has a key. Here each star stands for 2 children.

figure.title: Favourite sport
figure.alt: Pictogram of favourite sport. Each star is 2 children. Football: 4 stars, Swimming: 3 stars.

steps.say: A block graph shows each total as a bar.

figure.title: Favourite colour
figure.alt: Block graph of favourite colour. Red: 6, Blue: 10, Green: 8.

steps.say: To find how many more, take the smaller from the bigger.

check.prompt: Each star stands for 2 children. How many children chose football?

figure.title: Favourite sport
figure.alt: Pictogram of favourite sport. Each star is 2 children. Football: 5 stars, Swimming: 3 stars, Badminton: 4 stars.

hints: Each star is 2 children, so count in 2s.
Count the stars for football. Then double.

check.prompt: How many more children chose blue than red?

figure.title: Favourite colour
figure.alt: Block graph of favourite colour. Red: 6, Blue: 10, Green: 8.

hints: How many more means find the difference.
